PRIVACY POLICY

Last updated: February 2026.

1. WHAT WE COLLECT

We practice data minimization. We only collect the minimum necessary data to
provide the service: your email address, encrypted account content, and
anonymized usage metrics.

2. HOW WE USE AND SHARE YOUR DATA

We do not sell your personal data. Ever. We do not share your data with
advertising partners. We use sub-processors (listed publicly) strictly to
deliver the service.

3. END-TO-END ENCRYPTION

All user content is protected with end-to-end encryption. We perform
client-side encryption so that we cannot read your content.

4. RETENTION

Account data is retained for 30 days after account deletion, then purged.
Backups are deleted within 90 days. Logs are retained for 14 days.

5. YOUR RIGHTS

You have the right to erasure / deletion. You can delete your account from the
settings page at any time. We support data export and portability — download a
copy of your data in a machine-readable format in one click. We honor granular
consent and opt-out of all non-essential processing.

6. CHANGES TO THIS POLICY

We will notify you at least 30 days' prior notice before any material change,
via email and in-product notice.

7. SECURITY

We are independently audited annually (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001). We commit to
breach notification within 72 hours of becoming aware of a breach, consistent
with GDPR. We publish a transparency report quarterly.

8. DISPUTES

Disputes are resolved in court in your jurisdiction. You retain the right to
participate in class actions.
